owner: Parent orchestration after T01 renderer integration

storageProposal.imagesPerBatch: 44 ordinary; at most 47 including both hero far views and one family sheet
storageProposal.policy: Run one native batch at a time only after parent approval/preflight; inspect and archive a completed reviewed batch outside the working preview area before the next. No raw frame sequences. 8-angle turntables are single sheets. This manifest creates no grant and authorizes no native capture.
storageProposal.initialCondition: This delivery retains 48 CPU images. Before any native batch, parent must approve and perform archival of this CPU set so the combined active preview inventory stays <=48 images and <=512 MiB. No archival or deletion is authorized or performed by this manifest.

performanceMethod: Median asset-shown minus asset-hidden cost of adjacent paired frames; retain frame samples, draw calls, triangles, texture bytes, renderer/device/build and viewport in each performance.json.
captureProvenance: Exact source/export SHA256, app head/tree, renderer configuration, camera, lighting case, LOD, timestamp and capture tool identity for every native output; parent supplies approved grant separately.
